title: ZATCA Phase 2 Wave 25 in Zoho Books: Connect Fatoora Before 1 Feb 2027
description:
ZATCA wave 25: businesses in Saudi Arabia whose revenue subject to VAT went above SAR 187,500 in any year from 2022 to 2025 must integrate their e-invoicing with the Fatoora portal by 1 February 2027. In this video: what Phase 2 (the integration phase) means - clearance for standard B2B invoices, reporting within 24 hours for simplified invoices, the cryptographic stamp - who is in wave 25, and how to connect Zoho Books to Fatoora (OTP, CSID, Arabic fields, Push to Fatoora, statuses) step by step.
